catalogue.disclaimer: Custom NCCIA project exchange; not the normative ISO/IEC TS27034-5-1 schema. Role assignments/adoption and scoped verification pending. Source candidates are not passed evidence.

control.securityActivity: Implement approved MFA, password, recovery, throttling and session requirements
control.verificationActivity: Exercise factor enrollment/challenge/recovery, replay, rate limits, expiry and revocation; inspect secret handling
control.acceptance: Every adopted authentication/session requirement passes for exact release scope

control.objective: Protect role, circle, object and field access
control.securityActivity: Enforce server-side policies and scope on every read/write/export/file action
control.verificationActivity: Execute positive/negative role-circle-object-field matrix including guessed IDs
control.acceptance: Forbidden access fails and legitimate access succeeds on all inventoried endpoints

control.securityActivity: Validate content/type/size; generate paths; private storage; scanner and safe downloads
control.acceptance: Allowed safe files work; unsafe access/processing denied; production storage cannot execute uploads

control.securityActivity: Parameterized data/process calls and context-specific output encoding
control.verificationActivity: Review all query/command/render/URL sinks and execute hostile payload tests
control.acceptance: Untrusted data cannot change interpreter execution or output context

control.securityActivity: Quarantine and resource/isolation/network limits for PDF/OCR
control.verificationActivity: Malformed/oversize and failure tests with CPU/memory/output/concurrency observation
control.acceptance: Bounded safe failure without evidence leakage or service exhaustion

control.securityActivity: Encrypt restricted payloads; authenticate v2 metadata; serialize and anchor audit chain
control.verificationActivity: Tamper/deletion/reorder/concurrency tests, old-chain verification and independent checkpoint checks
control.acceptance: Altered/missing records detected and alerted; key/writer/checkpoint controls verified

control.securityActivity: Server handoff locks, approved corrections and version/concurrency checks
control.verificationActivity: Role-transition/stale update and atomic transaction tests
control.acceptance: No unauthorized post-handoff change or stale overwrite; audited correction succeeds

control.verificationActivity: Review data/log/export/provider flows and actual storage/key configuration
control.acceptance: Approved data handling enforced with verified encryption/disclosure/retention scope

control.securityActivity: Reviewed lockfile build, secret/SCA/code checks, artifact integrity and triage
control.verificationActivity: Inspect exact release scans/SBOM/provenance and exception approvals
control.acceptance: No unaccepted release findings; trusted reproducible scoped artifacts retained

control.securityActivity: Approved encrypted separated backup and recovery procedures
control.verificationActivity: Isolated restore with case/file/audit consistency and measured RTO/RPO
control.acceptance: Approved recovery objectives met with retained independent exercise evidence

control.securityActivity: Exact-platform benchmark profiles, segmentation, TLS/patching and monitoring
control.verificationActivity: Host/database/server/cloud scans plus manual configuration evidence
control.acceptance: All adopted deployment checks pass or have scoped approved exceptions
